mechanics.claim: Swain heals a fixed percent of max health each time he collects a Soul Fragment, so repeated kills near him grant repeated heals during a fight.
mechanics.quote: Upon claiming a fragment, he will {{tip|heal}} for {{as|6% of his '''maximum''' health}}.

mechanics.claim: Vision of Empire and Nevermove's recast can rip Soul Fragments directly out of champions, granting the stack/heal without needing a kill.
mechanics.quote: rip the {{as|Soul Fragments|buzzword3}} out of champions hit by ''{{ai|Vision of Empire|Swain}}'' or ''{{ai|Nevermove 2|Swain|Nevermove's}}'' recast
